result: {"ratings": {"Maya": {"rating": 4, "why": "I saw her lay the long bottom line from the nose along the belly and re-stand fallen dominoes near the middle, which was the biggest single stretch, and she handed the tail end over cleanly, though she was quiet and started late while the top line was still being laid."}, "Tom": {"rating": 5, "why": "I watched him carry the top line round the nose, lay the tail down past the bump to the tip, and fix the stray domino and the tip gap, all while telling people where he was working so nobody bumped; he repeated himself a bit at the end."}, "Leo": {"rating": 5, "why": "He found and fixed the jammed domino at the nose and the one in the belly seam, and kept everyone coordinated about who was working where and who should step back, which got nearly the whole run falling from the start."}}}
